name: Four-Dimensional Variational Data Assimilation
summary: Estimate dynamical initial states or controls from observations distributed across a time window.
core_idea: Minimize time-window observation mismatch plus background regularization under evolution constraints.
innovation: Uses an entire dynamical trajectory and adjoint-based gradients for windowed state estimation.
limitations: Optimization can be difficult for strongly nonlinear dynamics.

start_here.why: Clearer first explanation than operational implementation papers.

curation_note: Core method concept and checked source(s) recorded; suggested readings remain advisory and may be revised.
